svg.title: First-call context footprint by harness
svg.desc: Bar chart of the first-call context footprint (shape tokens, chars/4 of the serialized request body) for three harnesses on Claude Sonnet 4.5, MCP off, same repo and prompt. Copilot CLI about 14,877 tokens; Claude CLI about 27,217; Copilot in VS Code 20,598 (API prompt_tokens). The same model name carries a different amount of context depending on the harness. Not a quality ranking.
svg.text: The same model can start with very different context
First-call footprint in shape tokens (chars/4 of the request body). Claude Sonnet 4.5, MCP off, same repo and prompt.
Sources: structural-prefix/copilot/digest.json, structural-prefix/claude/digest.json (wire/relay body, chars/4); co-ide-exports/CO-IDE_agent_sonnet_MCPoff.json (export prompt_tokens).
Two values are tokenizer estimates and one is API-reported, so read this as order-of-magnitude shape, not a precise head-to-head. Not a quality ranking.
